시편 74:1.content: Maschil of Asaph. O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

시편 74:2.content: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

시편 74:3.content: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

시편 74:4.content: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

시편 74:5.content: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

시편 74:6.content: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

시편 74:7.content: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

시편 74:8.content: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

시편 74:9.content: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

시편 74:10.content: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

시편 74:11.content: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

시편 74:12.content: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

시편 74:13.content: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

시편 74:14.content: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

시편 74:15.content: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

시편 74:16.content: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

시편 74:17.content: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

시편 74:18.content: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

시편 74:19.content: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

시편 74:20.content: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

시편 74:21.content: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

시편 74:22.content: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

시편 74:23.content: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
